channel.title: BBC WoW Campaign
channel.description: Last 10 notes on BBC WoW Campaign

item.title: The Booty Bay Chronicle
item.description: Printed in Booty Bay, where we sell to anyone who pays and ask nobody their business. Year 29 since the opening of the Dark Portal.

item.title: Doomhammer
item.description: Doomhammer Appearance A black warhammer that has been carried by three Warchiefs, and the third one uses it as a shaman’s totem as often as a weapon.

item.title: Frostmourne
item.description: Frostmourne Appearance A greatsword of black ice with a skull in the crossguard, and it is cold in a way that has nothing to do with temperature.

item.title: Gorehowl
item.description: Gorehowl Appearance A huge orcish axe with a notch worn into the blade from a single, very famous blow.

item.title: Skull of Gul'dan
item.description: Skull of Gul’dan Appearance A green-glowing orcish skull that was, for a time, the most concentrated source of fel power on Azeroth.

item.title: Classes of Azeroth
item.description: Classes of Azeroth Decided — provisionally The faction locks below are enforced.

item.title: Death and Resurrection
item.description: Death and Resurrection The ruling No spirit healers. No corpse runs. No graveyard respawns.

item.title: House Rules
item.description: House Rules My deviations from the printed rules. Logged so I stay consistent.

item.title: Magic Schools and Damage Types
item.description: Magic Schools and Damage Types Azeroth runs on six. Everything resistible falls into one.

item.title: Playable Species at Launch
item.description: Playable Species at Launch Eight, and only eight. Four to a side.
